subject: literacy
concept: Decoding two-syllable words by breaking them into syllable chunks
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading multisyllabic decoding sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student physically splits a two-syllable word card into two chunk-tiles, sounds out each, then blends
exercise.pictorial: Student marks the syllable break in a set of pictured two-syllable words
exercise.abstract: Student reads two-syllable words aloud by decoding syllable by syllable

misconception_flags: tries to decode the whole word at once instead of breaking it into chunks

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
